tour.title: Demo tour
tour.finished: That's the whole tour. Thanks for trying ContaBu.

s1.d: You land in your own office with 3 client books: nothing to install or set up.

s2.d: Up top, the P&L for the year to date — the same one the client gets. Net income is shown before Pending: what has no category is declared, never hidden. On the right, what needs attention.

s3.d: The agent team on Nemotron works in visible steps: audit, verify on the web, judge, draft. Meanwhile open “Payroll: the bank only sees the net”: that's accounting knowledge, not just text.

s4.d: In Proposals, the vacation note is ONE row of the formula: STARBUCKS → Owner Draw only from Aug 3 to 17. The history test shows the 9 rows it changes before anything moves. Approve it.

s5.d: Transactions → Rules → View as formula: the whole book is one chain of IFs, read top to bottom. The row the agent proposed is marked.

s6.d: In Bookkeeping, select a row (try a Starbucks in Paris): the panel shows which rule set its category, its history, and the web evidence with its link. Rows with a dot also show what the agents found.

s7.d: Change the category of a Pending row: it gets a ✎ and no rule ever touches it again. What you write by hand wins.

s8.d: Bank feeds → Link bank (Plaid sandbox: user_good / pass_good). Transactions come in through the same engine as a statement: rules first, the rest Pending.

demo.title: ContaBu — AI-native bookkeeping for the bookkeeper
demo.lead: Agents on NVIDIA Nemotron (Nebius Token Factory) audit the book, check merchants on the web and propose rules. They never touch a number or set a category: the bookkeeper approves, a deterministic engine applies the rules, and every total comes from SQL. The architecture large companies use, for the small bookkeeper.
